## What changes / 改动内容

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.
说明解决的问题、修改后的行为，以及相关 Issue。

## Validation / 验证

List the checks you actually ran and your environment. State any checks you could not run.
列出实际运行的检查与环境，说明未覆盖的检查。

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] The change is focused; relevant documentation is updated. / 改动聚焦，相关文档已更新。
- [ ] Relevant validation is recorded above. / 已记录适用的验证。
- [ ] No real email, mailbox/cache export, credentials, or private information is included. / 未提交真实邮件、缓存、凭据或私人信息。
- [ ] Original-message preservation and Mail privacy behavior are maintained, or changes are explicitly discussed. / 保留原文及 Mail 隐私行为，或已明确讨论变更。
